subject: SQRT function
notes: CONFORMS. Citation re-derived mechanically, not inherited: `cite.py --check 15.84.3 "Argument-1 shall be of class numeric"` -> OK §15.84.3 1). THE CLAUSE NUMBER IS THE TRAP HERE AND I RE-RAN IT: §15.81.3 r1 (SIGN) carries the IDENTICAL sentence and an earlier pass in this repo took it for SQRT's; the in-code comment at IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs:515-517 records that miss. READ: IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs#Verified line 521 carries ["SQRT"] = Uniform('n', "§15.84.3 r1"), and Admissible('n') (line 841) resolves to [CobolClass.Numeric] — the §8.5.2.1 Table-2 CLASS axis, so a numeric-EDITED display item (Table 2 class alphanumeric) is correctly EXCLUDED, and the comment at 830-841 records that the widening argument was raised twice and refuted from §8.8.1.1 ('an identifier referencing a NUMERIC data item'). The screen runs on the generic path: IntrinsicBinder.cs#BindIntrinsicCore calls CheckArgumentClasses(sig, args) at line 587, AFTER the arity guard and BEFORE every bespoke arm, so the row is live for SQRT without a per-function arm. Diagnostic COBOL1627. The operand's class comes from IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs#CandidateClasses, which returns a SET rather than a scalar (§8.3.3.6.4 GR4, PB48): figurative ZERO presents {Numeric, Alphanumeric, National, Boolean} and PASSES (correct — 'the screen accepts ZERO here and there' is GR4 behaviour, not a hole); SPACE/HIGH-VALUE/LOW-VALUE/QUOTE present {Alphanumeric, National} and are rejected; ALL literal-1 carries its literal's own class (§8.3.3.6.3 SR1a); an index-name and an index DATA item both classify CobolClass.Index (ClassOfPlace keys USAGE before the category table, R27) and are rejected; a nested intrinsic contributes ITS result category (ClassOf1 line 352), so FUNCTION SQRT(FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(X)) is rejected. Violation() fails OPEN only at line 910 (candidates empty = class not statically decidable) and for an unmodelled figurative kind — no ordinary operand shape falls in that hole. TESTS ARE SPEC-DERIVED AND BOTH-SIDED: conformance:cases/_unassigned/pb52-intrinsic-argument-stage is FUNCTION SQRT(SPACE) -> COBOL1627 with the §15.84.3 r1 derivation in its header, and conformance:cases/15.84.4-Returned-value-rules/pb52_intrinsic_argument_stage is the legal side (SQRT(NI) and SQRT(4) both = 2.00 in the golden .out), which is the half that guards against the PB1 over-rejection direction. EDITIONS not taken from IntrinsicCatalog's row: SQRT is a function of the 1989 Intrinsic Function Module amendment carried unchanged into 2002/2014/2023 and §15.84.3 r1 has no edition delta, so the batch default stands.
